videos.title: Behind the Music (2021)
videos.description: In this posthumous episode of Behind the Music (2002), those closest to Bob Marley share his journey, pioneering reggae music globally. Through archival interviews, Bob shared how he overcame hatred and hardship on his way to stardom. His mission was to lift the oppressed through song. With hits like ""One Love"" and ""Get Up Stand Up,"" he spread the gospel of the Rastafari. Bob's life began in Jamaica where he found solace in making socially conscious music. With the Wailers, he recorded chart topping songs that have crossed over worldwide. Bob earned the means to take care of his community.
